Pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas na Cyncly!

Sobre nós

A Cyncly é uma potência global em tecnologia com mais de 2.400 funcionários e mais de 70.000 clientes em mais de 100 países. A Cyncly transforma a forma como produtos e espaços personalizáveis são imaginados, projetados, vendidos, gerenciados e fabricados. Nossas soluções de software de ponta a ponta conectam designers profissionais, varejistas e fabricantes ao maior repositório de conteúdo de produtos do mundo. Hoje, nossos negócios abrangem as indústrias de Cozinha e Banheiro, Móveis, Janelas, Vidros e Portas, e Pisos, com operação na América do Norte e do Sul, Europa, Ásia-Pacífico e África.

A Cyncly traz mais de 30 anos de experiência para oferecer mais valor aos nossos clientes por meio de um portfólio expandido de soluções de ponta a ponta. Nossa presença global nos permite fornecer suporte e vendas de classe mundial com um toque local, garantindo a melhor experiência possível para o cliente.

A Cyncly está embarcando em uma jornada empolgante enquanto continuamos a expandir por meio de um forte crescimento orgânico e aquisições complementares, apoiadas por empresas de private equity líderes especializadas em tecnologia.

Sobre a vaga

Como Demonstrador de Software você será responsável pela demonstração das nossas soluções de projetos existentes no grupo, atendendo clientes da indústria moveleira.

Seu papel é fundamental no processo de vendas, pois, através de você, o cliente poderá conhecer melhor as funcionalidades das nossas soluções, que trarão sucesso para o negócio dele.

É importante que você tenha bons conhecimentos sobre os processos da indústria moveleira, que serão essenciais durante o processo de demonstração.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Preparar ambiente e fluxo de demonstração como computador, sistema, banco de dados e outros que se façam necessário;
  • Demonstrar sistemas de projetos para segmento moveleiro, de forma remota e presencial para clientes, esclarecer dúvidas e acompanhar o pós-vendas;
  • Preencher relatório de demonstração após cada apresentação, a fim de manter atualizados registros;
  • Construir materiais de treinamento para equipe comercial;
  • Preencher briefing técnico para auxiliar o Executivos de Vendas na criação da proposta comercial;
  • Realizar diagnósticos e levantamento de necessidades junto aos prospects e clientes;
  • Ser apoio técnico ao setor comercial sempre que necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo ou cursando em arquitetura, design de interiores, administração, engenharias, gestão de produção ou áreas relacionadas a TI;
  • Experiência em atendimento a clientes;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Espanhol avançado;
  • Inglês será considerado um diferencial.

O que oferecemos

  • Plano de Saúde nacional Unimed (estendido aos seus dependentes);
  • Plano Odontológico nacional Unimed (estendido aos seus dependentes);
  • Alelo Tudo (você pode dividir o valor da melhor forma pra você, entre alimentação e refeição);
  • Vale transporte ou auxílio home office;
  • Gympass/Wellhub;
  • ZenKlub e Plano de Saúde Pet (Guapeco);
  • Auxílio educação para Graduação, Pós Graduação | MBA | Mestrado | Doutorado, auxílio idiomas, acesso a plataformas de educação corporativa globais e verba para treinamentos;
  • Convênios com cinema, farmácias e restaurantes próximos à empresa;
  • Convênios com instituições de ensino superior e escolas de idioma;
  • Day Off no mês do seu aniversário;
  • Seguro de Vida Prudential;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Equipamentos de trabalho fornecidos pela empresa;
  • PLR anual;
  • Cyncly Store - compras facilitadas para itens corporativos.

Trabalhando para nós

Na Cyncly, chamamos nossa equipe de OneCyncly, um reflexo de como atuamos juntos como um só time, unidos por nosso propósito: impulsionar negócios que dão vida aos espaços. Nossa força vem da diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e habilidades – e prosperamos quando trabalhamos com abertura, confiança e respeito.

Aqui, você fará parte de um grupo de colegas que assumem responsabilidades, resolvem problemas e focam em gerar impacto. Valorizamos a curiosidade, acolhemos novas ideias e enxergamos os erros como oportunidades de aprendizado. Você terá liberdade para trabalhar de forma flexível e autônoma, com o apoio de colegas e líderes comprometidos com o seu desenvolvimento.

Celebramos as diferentes formas de contribuição e incentivamos todos – de todas as origens – a trazerem sua autenticidade para o ambiente de trabalho. Porque, quando colaboramos, nos desafiamos e compartilhamos conhecimento, construímos algo melhor juntos.

Se você busca um lugar onde suas ideias são valorizadas, seu crescimento é incentivado e seu trabalho transforma os espaços onde as pessoas vivem, trabalham e se divertem – venha fazer parte do nosso time.

title: Salesforce Data Migration Specialist
description:
Overview

About Us : Kelley Austin takes a different approach to Salesforce Consulting by putting our employees first. That’s not hyperbole, either. Our team takes a proactive approach to employee satisfaction by having every single person fill out a “happiness list,” which comprises the top ten things each employee finds happiness in outside of work. We review those happiness lists regularly to ensure everyone is checking most of the boxes and adjust their project load, responsibilities, or schedule accordingly if not. Look at our benefits and perks below to learn more about our culture. We’re growing fast (more than doubling YOY) but staying diligent in hiring the best possible people who don’t just want a job, but will actually care about the success of their co-workers and clients. Our growth, coupled with the distinction of being recognized as the 'fastest Salesforce Implementation Partner to achieve Platinum / Summit status,' attests to the success of our approach. Take a look at the ‘About You’ and ‘Responsibilities’ below to learn more :

Benefits

  • Base Salary
  • Work From Home Flexibility
  • Flexible PTO (we treat people like adults here)
  • Paid Holidays (including an entire week off around Christmas and New Year)

Tools We Use

  • As a technology software consulting company, we use many tools, but the big four are Google Drive, Slack, Lucid Chart, and Salesforce, of course.

Perks Of The Job

  • You won’t really find egos here. We hire slowly and purposefully to keep our culture strong and our team cohesive.
  • We don’t say yes to every client and are not afraid to part ways with a client, either. If there’s no mutual respect or success involved, we politely decline and help them find a different partner. That means fewer ‘tough’ clients and more clients who “get it” and work harmoniously together.
  • We offer half a dozen different clubs like book club, health club, movie club, hobby club, and more. These bring people together to grow intellectually and get to know one another outside of project work.
  • We work an average of 40 hours per week (I know, that’s unheard of in consulting, but we stand by it).

About You

We are seeking a Data Migration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in Salesforce, Salesforce SOQL, Salesforce APEX, relational databases, SQL, scripting, and large-scale data migration. This role is highly execution-focused and detail-oriented — you will be designing and running ETL processes, writing queries and scripts, validating data quality, and ensuring successful end-to-end migrations between enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and manage end-to-end data migration projects, including extraction, transformation, loading, and validation.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL and SOQL queries for data validation, migration, and reconciliation.
  • Build, configure, and run ETL jobs to move and transform data across Salesforce, ERP, and external databases.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (APEX, Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar) for data processing, cleansing, and quality checks.
  • Perform data profiling, mapping, and transformation to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration issues such as data mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and integrity errors.
  • Collaborate with internal and external Salesforce, integration, and business teams to coordinate cutovers and validate migrated data.
  • Document migration procedures, scripts, mappings, and reconciliation steps for repeatability and compliance.
  • Ensure all migrations follow best practices for data quality, security, and governance.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • 5+ years of direct experience in data migration, ETL, or database engineering roles.
  • Strong technical expertise in relational databases (Salesforce, Oracle, SQL Server, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (query optimization, joins, stored procedures).
  • Practical experience with Salesforce SOQL, APEX, and Salesforce data model.
  • Proven track record in data migration projects, including reconciliation and cutover planning.
  • Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar.
  • Familiarity with ETL tools, APIs, and bulk data processing.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.

NOTE : Kelley Austin will not be able to sponsor applicants for work visas.

title: Modeling Analyst II (Data Scientist)
description:
Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians!

At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses — by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.

We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We’ve been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market.

Our goal? Deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike.

We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action. We’re looking for people who are curious, hands-on, and driven by impact — who want to solve real problems, work with strong teams, and rethink what’s possible.

If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose — this is your place.

Responsibilities

As a Modeling Analyst on Data Science team, you will be responsible for:

  • Monitor and analyze the performance of credit models, focusing on stability, accuracy, and business impact.
  • Support the design, execution, and analysis of A/B tests and other experiments related to credit decision strategies.
  • Maintain organized data structures and technical documentation (data books, variable dictionaries, version control).
  • Perform backtesting analyses using bureau data, identifying patterns and opportunities for segmentation.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis to support new modeling initiatives or model updates.
  • Analyze and evaluate model features, including univariate, bivariate analysis and feature drift monitoring.
  • Assist in building reusable analytical pipelines for scalable and sustainable insights.
  • Advanced SQL: ability to handle large datasets and write efficient, optimized queries.
  • Python: experience with libraries like Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn.
  • Experience with ML algorithms: logistic regression, random forest, gradient boosting, etc.
  • Models explanation: SHAP, bivariate analysis, weight of evidence, etc.
  • Databricks: familiarity with collaborative notebooks, workflows, and Delta Lake integration.
  • Git: version control, repository organization, and collaboration best practices.
  • Data visualization and communication: ability to translate technical findings into actionable business insights.
  • A/B testing and statistics: solid understanding of experimental design and statistical significance.
  • Basic knowledge of predictive modeling: understanding of metrics such as AUC, KS, precision, and recall.
  • Analytical mindset and results-oriented, with a strong focus on problem-solving.
  • Passion for innovation and experimentation.
  • Knowledge of data modeling principles and experience in building robust and scalable data models.
  • Strong mathematical skills and ability to optimize complex problems.
  • Experience in activities related to data science.

Bonus Points

  • Proficiency with PySpark for distributed data processing in large-scale environments.
  • Experience with MLOps in machine learning projects.
  • Familiarity with model monitoring in production environments.
  • Exposure to Open Finance, credit bureau data, or behavioral features.
  • Previous experience in fintechs or financial services companies.
  • Competitive and market-aligned salary.
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
  • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.
  • Spanish or Portuguese classes.

Diversity & Inclusion at RecargaPay
At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

About the use of your Data
By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

title: Página da Vaga | Coordenador de Operações
description:
Job description

Estamos buscando uma pessoa Coordenadora de operações para o Time Vetta!

Você fará parte de uma equipe de desenvolvimento de produtos de software com foco em Energia & Sustentabilidade com cultura ágil e focada em entregas de valor com foco no cliente, principalmente dos segmentos de siderurgia e metalurgia. Se você tem experiência em gestão de pessoas, otimizar processos e garantir a eficiência na entrega de soluções inovadoras, esta oportunidade é para você. Nosso objetivo é construir produtos que transformam o setor de energia, promovendo um futuro mais sustentável.

VOCÊ JÁ CONHECE A VETTA?

Na Vetta, acreditamos que a tecnologia e a inovação são essenciais para criar um futuro mais sustentável e eficiente para todos. Como uma empresa líder em digitalização industrial, nossas soluções estão ajudando clientes em todo o mundo a reduzir o consumo de energia, a melhorar a eficiência operacional e apoiar a transição energética através da descarbonização.

Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos emocionantes e desafiadores com alguns dos maiores especialistas da indústria . Além disso, você fará parte de uma equipe dedicada em gerar um impacto positivo no mundo e em ajudar nossos clientes a alcançar seus objetivos de negócios.O Time Vetta sabe a importância do trabalho em equipe e da colaboração para alcançar resultados que atingem todo o globo – ao mesmo tempo que a carreira de cada um é transformada.

Se você quer compartilhar a sua perspectiva para um mundo mais sustentável, venha ser parte do Time Vetta!


Main responsibilities

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Gestão de Equipe: Liderar e motivar a equipe de desenvolvimento de software, garantindo que os produtos sejam entregues no prazo e com a qualidade esperada.
  • Otimização de Processos: Definir e implementar processos eficientes para o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até a implantação e manutenção.
  • Coordenação Interdepartamental: Atuar como ponte entre as equipes de desenvolvimento, produto, design, marketing e vendas, assegurando que todos estejam alinhados com os objetivos do negócio.
  • Métricas e Análise: Estabelecer e monitorar KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) para avaliar a performance da equipe e a eficiência dos processos.
  • Gestão de Recursos: Planejar e alocar recursos (humanos e financeiros) de forma estratégica para maximizar a produtividade e a entrega de valor.
  • Garantia de Qualidade: Supervisionar a implementação de práticas de QA (Quality Assurance) para garantir a robustez, segurança e confiabilidade dos produtos.
  • Formação de Equipe de Alto Desempenho: Desenvolver e implementar programas de treinamento e mentoria para a equipe, garantindo a evolução contínua das competências e a formação de um time de alta performance. Além de liderar o processo de onboarding de novos colaboradores.
  • Padronização de Processos: Definir e garantir a padronização de práticas e metodologias de desenvolvimento entre as diversas equipes de produto, promovendo a consistência e a eficiência.
  • Inovação: Manter-se atualizado(a) com as tendências do mercado, identificando oportunidades de melhoria da eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software e produto.

Requirements and skills

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Experiência comprovada como Coordenador(a) ou Gerente de Operações, ou em papel similar, em equipes de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Forte conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, etc.);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (utilizamos Azure DevOps);
  • Conhecimento para formação de equipes de alto desempenho utilizando recursos como IA, automação, etc;
  • Habilidade em liderança, comunicação e resolução de problemas;
  • Conhecimento técnico sobre o ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Paixão pelo setor de Energia & Sustentabilidade e interesse em tecnologias para energias renováveis, eficiência energética, e smart grids.

O que será um diferencial:

  • Conhecimento prévio no setor de energia ou sustentabilidade;
  • Certificações em gestão de projetos (PMP, CSM, etc.);
  • Experiência com DevOps e automação.

Additional information

NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS:

Sendo uma empresa voltada para pessoas, buscamos sempre valorizar a nossa equipe. Ao entrar para o Time Vetta, oferecemos:

  • Cartão Flash comvale-alimentação/refeição deR$ 32,00 por dia , aceito em diversos estabelecimentos para você usar como preferir.
  • Auxílio home office deR$ 100,00/mês eflexibilidade no horário de trabalho.
  • Se você trabalhar no escritório da Vetta, em Belo Horizonte, teráVale-Transporte .
  • Pensando na sua saúde e bem-estar, oferecemosPlano de Saúde SulAmérica ePlano Odontológico Bradesco ,com a possibilidade de inclusão dos seus dependentes.
  • WellHub, TotalPass e UniCamente , para você cuidar da sua saúde integralmente, com acesso a atividades físicas e a profissionais de diversas áreas da saúde.
  • Clube de Descontos e Recompensas , com descontos em diversas redes de produtos e de serviços.
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida, para os pais e mães viverem essa fase com tranquilidade.
  • PLR - conforme tabela do sindicato.

E TEM MAIS...

  • Day-Off de Aniversário.
  • No Dress Code. Vista-se com o que te deixa confortável!
  • Programa de Incentivo à Formação Contínua e Capacitação , para que você possa continuar aprendendo e compartilhando experiências.
  • Quer indicar alguém para a Vetta? Temos Programa de Indicação de Talentos.

Se interessou em fazer parte do time? Cadastre-se agora! Ficaremos felizes em ter você conosco.

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

HR Professional | Passionate about Culture, Growth & People

Who We Are

ENG (engbim.com) is a BIM company that specializes in hands-on, field-focused BIM services. Founded in 2007, we have positioned ourselves as the largest and most experienced BIM production service provider in the United States, having completed 5,000 BIM projects with a dedicated team of over 600 staff members. We provide MEP Modeling, VDC/BIM Management, Laser Scanning, and Scan to BIM services, as well as a comprehensive array of BIM production services to architects, engineers, and owners.

The Role

The BIM Specialist role generally involves covering the modeling of different trades (MEP), depending on your background and expertise, whose extent will depend on the scope of the project (specific zones or entire buildings), and whose quality will go according to clients’ requirements and the services provided by the team you end up joining. This position requires a high level of modeling quality (expertise, technical knowledge, LOD and QAQC capabilities), and more autonomy in its self-management and modeling capabilities (studying whatever's necessary according to each trade). A BIM Specialist saves the client problems, detecting possible conflicts throughout the initial information review and the modeling and coordination phases.

Minimum mandatory requirements include:

  • An excellent level of English is an absolute must, both spoken and written . Aspiring candidates must be able to keep up with fluent conversations both with native and non-native speakers. Candidates without this requirement will NOT be considered .
  • Solid experience modeling HVAC and plumbing in Revit for commercial, industrial, healthcare, and residential construction . This can include things like process piping , ductwork and sheet metal , and mechanical equipment (pumps , AHUs , RTUs , chillers and boilers ), and for plumbing, domestic water , sanitary drainage and gray water , stormwater , medical gases , compressed air lines , pumps , heaters and hangers .
  • Experience coordinating or clash-detecting through Navisworks (Revizto can also be considered but Navisworks will be prioritized), knowledge of BIM coordination, clash report , QAQC and model accuracy .
  • A mechanical or civil engineering bachelors degree (architects could be considered but only if they have extensive experience modeling and coordinating MEP trades themselves).

Specific requirements will vary depending on the position and service. Experience with Level Of Detail (LOD) 400 and projects based in the US , or constructability knowledge related to that country will be a huge differential . Other desirable requirements are:

  • Familiarity with BIM add-ins (e.g., Evolve , SysQue , Fabrication Parts ).
  • Experience in conceptual design / BIM Design assist.
  • AutoCAD Plant 3D knowledge.
  • Dynamo/Python knowledge applied to BIM .
  • On-site/field experience .
  • Ability to produce detailed models, including real-world fittings and connection types .

Please know if you don't have experience working with Revit in formal jobs, it will be hard to consider your profile. Please DON'T apply if you don't have the necessary English level.

Work from Anywhere: Flexibility to work remotely or from a coworking space.

No-Policy for PTO: Recharge with flexible paid time off when you need it.

Tech & Office Allowances: Upgrade your workspace with our one-time allowances. With "Pimp up your Devices," and “Home Office set up allowance” you can upgrade gadgets for a better experience.

Monthly Internet Allowance: Stay connected with a monthly allowance for internet and expenses.

Highly Competitive Compensation Package: Includes both fixed and variable payments, all processed in our local currency, USD.

Join us and grow in a flexible, innovative environment!

Compensation will be in USD, competitive and commensurate with experience.

Before you apply, make sure your CV is in English, otherwise your application can’t be considered.

Join to apply for the Business Development Representative role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Canonical is a remote-first global company that publishes Ubuntu and open-source enterprise solutions for cloud, developer, IoT and AI. Ubuntu is the fastest growing Linux distribution and ranks as the number #1 OS in the cloud.
In partnership with Google, Amazon, IBM and Microsoft, Canonical helps companies become more agile, productive and adopt new technologies faster. Examples of customer success include AI, Blockchain, IoT, Advanced Robotics and self-driving cars, where Ubuntu is the preferred development platform.
The role of a Business Development Representative at Canonical
Canonical is profitable and growing. We consider our sales development organization to be the best technology sales academy in the market, and as such, we select exceptional and ambitious candidates to join our team. You will enjoy this role if you are organized, persistent, charismatic and hard-working. You will need to be interested in tech and its business implications. In this role, you will collaborate with a regional sales and marketing team, and your primary objective will be to find customer projects that fit our product lines and spread the good name of Canonical across multiple different industries and geographies.
Click HERE to watch our SDR team discuss their role in Canonical
The role entails

  • Execute outbound sales & marketing campaigns
  • Research information about prospective customers and market trends
  • Generate high-quality leads for Senior Sellers to fuel a multi-million dollar pipeline
  • Own and close SMB opportunities within your designated territory
  • Collaborate across multiple teams and senior stakeholders to drive results
  • Help define the processes and policies for the team
  • Travel to events and conferences worldwide, presenting on booths and driving face-to-face marketing and sales opportunities
What we are looking for in you
  • Demonstrated success in SDR or outbound sales, with a track record of exceeding annual quotas and consistently driving qualified pipeline growth
  • Experience navigating prospective accounts from and into a senior executive level to identify new customer opportunities
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Passion for business and technology
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem solving and cross team collaboration
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Verbal and written communication and negotiation skills
  • Result driven with an over-achiever spirit
  • Persistence & perseverance
  • Growth mindset - people from our team develop into all departments within the sales organization (Channel, IoT, Enterprise Sales, etc)
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Analista Back-End Sênior
description:
Missão

Atuar em equipe ágil no desenvolvimento, evolução e sustentação de produtos digitais de missão crítica, entregando valor contínuo e com alta qualidade. Garantir a resiliência, escalabilidade e observabilidade das soluções em ambientes distribuídos e cloud native, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software, padrões arquiteturais avançados e cultura DevOps para assegurar a satisfação do cliente e a estabilidade em produção

Responsabilidades

  • Participar e contribuir ativamente para as cerimônias ágeis, colaborando na evolução técnica e na construção de um ambiente saudável, produtivo e de alta performance;
  • Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir aplicações distribuídas e escaláveis utilizando Java (11+), Spring Boot e arquitetura Cloud Native;
  • Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários, integração, carga e contrato) e code review rigoroso;
  • Diagnosticar e corrigir incidentes complexos em produção, aplicando práticas de observabilidade (logging, metrics, tracing) e análise de causa raiz;
  • Realizar deploys seguros e automatizados em múltiplos ambientes utilizando CI / CD, pipelines robustos e infraestrutura como código;
  • Propor e implementar melhorias técnicas que elevem a resiliência, segurança, escalabilidade e custo-eficiência dos sistemas;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de DevOps, QA, Segurança e Produto para alinhar soluções técnicas com as necessidades do negócio;
  • Contribuir para a evolução da arquitetura adotando padrões de microsserviços, event-driven e integração assíncrona;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para desenvolvedores plenos e juniores, apoiando revisões, mentorias e disseminação de boas práticas.

Requisitos recomendados

Formação : Superior completo na área de Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Ciências da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos específicos

  • Java (versão 11 ou superior) com sólida experiência em POO e padrões de projeto;
  • Spring Framework (Boot, Data, Cloud, Security) com foco em aplicações Cloud Native;
  • Experiência comprovada em arquitetura baseada em microsserviços e integração assíncrona;
  • Criação e manutenção de APIs RESTful e GraphQL com alto throughput e baixa latência;
  • Experiência em MongoDB e bancos relacionais, com uso avançado de índices, agregações e modelagem para alta performance;
  • Redis ou outros mecanismos de cache distribuído;
  • Experiência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ) e padrões de eventos;
  • Domínio de Git e práticas de versionamento avançadas (Git Flow, trunk-based);
  • Experiência sólida em testes automatizados (TDD / BDD), testes de integração e carga;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Docker, Kubernetes e práticas de observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry);
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e cultura DevOps;
  • Experiência em ambientes distribuídos e de alta disponibilidade, com requisitos de resiliência e tolerância a falhas.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Ansible, Helm);
  • Certificações em Java, Kubernetes ou Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure);
  • Experiência com monitoramento e tuning de aplicações Java para redução de consumo de recursos;
  • Participação em projetos com alta volumetria de dados e tráfego.

Experiência

  • Desejável experiência com atuação em times ágeis e em ambientes de alta disponibilidade;
  • Desejável vivência com práticas de DevOps e integração contínua.

How We Work

At WeTravel, our Sales team runs lean, fast, and collaboratively. You’ll manage the entire sales cycle—from cold outreach to closing the deal—with a strong focus on volume-based activity. What sets this role apart is the high degree of autonomy and accountability: you'll be expected to spend the majority of your time prospecting, demoing, and following up with qualified leads.

We embrace a consultative sales approach, using tools like HubSpot to manage pipelines and stay organized. If you’re someone who loves helping business owners and thrives in a high-energy, remote-friendly environment, this is the place for you.

You should apply if you:

  • Are fluent in English and Spanish (and any other languages? Highlight them in your resume!).

  • Have excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Are passionate about helping SME travel companies grow.

You might not be the right fit if you:

  • Dislike making cold calls or engaging in proactive outreach.

  • Struggle with remote work autonomy or time management.

On a Weekly Basis You Will Find Yourself

  • Meeting or exceeding weekly KPIs for outreach, demos, and new bookings.

title: Business Services Team Manager
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.

This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.

We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy. Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.

This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.

Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.

Our team also provides traditional 'EA' services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they set and deliver to expectations on specific kinds of work. They schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.

Location: Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office, such as London, Taipei and Beijing

Responsibilities

  • Travel approvals, logistics and operations
  • Expense review in line with policies
  • Planning of complex company events four times a year
  • Company offices that provide executive briefing and operational facilities
  • Our global duty of care, health and safety programs with comprehensive policies and practices

Qualifications

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Strategic Account Executive role at Canonical .

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.

We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.

Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.

Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems

description:
Overview

A Koopere está com oportunidade para projeto no GRUPO SUPERO. Buscamos uma pessoa que será responsável por liderar integralmente o desenvolvimento de um novo produto portuário desde a fase de discovery até a entrega final. Esta pessoa atuará como PO, com foco em análise de requisitos, discovery e mapeamento de processos, sendo a figura central na gestão, análise e construção do produto.

Principais Atividades

  • Assumir o desenvolvimento de um produto portuário, conduzindo cronograma, entregas e relacionamento com stakeholders;
  • Liderar e facilitar workshops de Discovery, aplicando técnicas como entrevistas, mapeamento de processos, jornada do usuário, mapas de empatia e ideação colaborativa, utilizando ferramentas como Miro;
  • Atuar como Product Owner, responsável pela definição da visão do produto, construção e priorização do backlog, roadmap e organização das sprints;
  • Executar a análise de requisitos, transformando necessidades de negócio em especificações funcionais e técnicas claras;
  • Criar protótipos navegáveis no Figma, com foco em experiência (UX) e interface (UI), validando soluções com usuários e desenvolvedores;
  • Elaborar documentação de requisitos e critérios de aceite, garantindo clareza para a equipe técnica;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento junto à equipe, assegurando entregas consistentes e alinhadas à visão do produto;
  • Gerenciar riscos e impedimentos ao longo da execução, propondo ações preventivas e corretivas;
  • Controlar mudanças de escopo, atualizando backlog e documentação de requisitos;
  • Conduzir validações funcionais e apoiar a homologação com os stakeholders;
  • Acompanhar KPIs e OKRs, assegurando geração de valor real para o negócio;
  • Utilizar o Azure DevOps para gestão do backlog, documentação e acompanhamento do produto.

Quais Vivências Esperamos De Você

  • Experiência como PO com atuação em discovery, análise de requisitos e mapeamento de processos;
  • Vivência em projetos de criação de produtos do zero, com domínio do ciclo de vida do produto;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em técnicas de discovery, priorização de funcionalidades e definição de valor de negócio;
  • Experiência prática com Figma (UX/UI, prototipagem e validação de jornada do usuário);
  • Certificação PSPO (Professional Scrum Product Owner) ou CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner);
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado para tratativas com fornecedores.

Será Legal Se Você Tiver

  • Experiência em projetos no setor portuário ou logístico;
  • Vivência com Design Thinking e modelagem de processos (BPMN).

Tecnologias Indispensáveis

  • Azure DevOps;
  • Figma;
  • Miro (para discovery e facilitação de workshops);
  • Power BI ou Tableau para acompanhamento de métricas e KPIs;
  • Conhecimento em métodos ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, Lean Inception, Design Sprint);
  • Noções de APIs, integrações e microsserviços para melhor detalhamento de requisitos técnicos;
  • Experiência em User Story Mapping e BDD/Gherkin para critérios de aceitação.

title: Technology and Product QA Engineer Specialist | Business Architecture Services Brazil (Remote)
description:
QA Engineer Specialist | Business Architecture Services

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.
*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.
THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a QA Engineer Specialist in our BASE area in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country.
At the BASE (Business Architecture Services) Focus Area, we build the heart of the Wellhub business model. Our mission is to help Wellhub build a truly scalable platform to support dozens of millions of active users and clients around the world with high availability while being flexible and extensible to incorporate new business models. In this role, you will go beyond testing — you will drive quality across services and teams, mentoring engineers, shaping automation frameworks, and ensuring Wellhub continues to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-centric solutions.
As a Q.A. Engineer you will take end-to-end ownership of the quality of the most critical product flows and deliveries. You will be involved from the very beginning of the product lifecycle, helping with the product requirements, defining and building comprehensive test scenarios, performing in-depth exploratory testing, and automating mission-critical flows. Your work will ensure backward compatibility, performance, reliability, and overall product excellence.In addition, you will define and continuously improve the testing pipeline, driving best practices in automated testing and mentoring developers to elevate the team’s quality standards.
This role combines strong analytical QA expertise with engineering skills in a critical position that delivers meaningful impact across the organization, spanning from overall test planning to execution.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead the design and implementation of test strategies (manual, automated, and exploratory) for complex distributed systems.
  • Define and evolve quality standards, frameworks, and processes across multiple services.
  • Mentor and guide software engineers, fostering a culture of ownership for quality.
  • Partner with product managers and engineering leaders to assess risks, define acceptance criteria, and shape solutions.
  • Drive test automation adoption, building scalable frameworks for APIs, backend services, and integrations.
  • Champion performance, load, and reliability testing as part of the development lifecycle.
  • Ensure quality gates and CI/CD pipelines provide fast, reliable feedback to teams.
  • Identify systemic quality issues and propose improvements in architecture, tooling, and processes.
  • Act as a quality advocate, ensuring we deliver not just working software, but trusted and delightful experiences to users.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A QA professional with a bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Solid experience in QA Engineering, with a strong background in automation (Cypress, Playwright, Rest-assured, SuperTest, Bruno, Cucumber, Postman, or similar).
  • Experienced with API testing (REST/GraphQL) and data validations in SQL/NoSQL databases.
  • Familiar with cloud-native environments (AWS/GCP) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Preferred but not required experience in performance and load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling, Locust, K6) and their application to large-scale systems.
  • Experienced in risk-based testing, exploratory testing, and working with distributed systems.
  • Solid experience working with distributed systems using asynchronous communication (Kafka)
  • Familiar with SQL, being able to navigate complex data domains
  • Comfortable leading cross-team initiatives, influencing quality practices, and driving alignment on testing strategies.
  • Solid communication skills in English, able to articulate quality goals, trade-offs, and improvements across cultures and geographies.
  • A proactive, collaborative problem-solver who sees quality as a shared responsibility across engineering.
  • Experience with observability tools (Datadog, NewRelic, Kibana, Prometheus, Grafana Loki, or similar).
  • Preferred but not required experience with contract testing (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract, Dredd, or similar).

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in QA Engineering, automation test, API testing, and distributed systems using asynchronous communicationare mandatory requirements

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. description:
Ready to accelerate your career?

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices.
We’re building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

What you'll do
We’re looking for an Account Executive to accelerate Clara’s growth by generating and closing new business opportunities through 100% outbound efforts. You’ll play a key role in expanding Clara’s reach in Brazil by identifying, engaging, and converting high-potential prospects.

This is a self-driven sales role where you’ll manage your own pipeline end to end—from prospecting to closing—while representing Clara with clarity, discipline, and energy. Success will be measured by your ability to hit and exceed aggressive new client acquisition targets.

You will:

  • Own the outbound sales motion for your territory, from lead sourcing to signed contracts

  • Build and manage a high-volume pipeline through proactive prospecting and outreach

  • Set and consistently exceed monthly and quarterly sales goals

  • Track and optimize performance against KPIs such as outreach volume, conversion rate, and closed deals

  • Maintain detailed records of all sales activity and client interactions using Hubspot CRM

  • Act as a brand ambassador, clearly communicating Clara’s value proposition to potential clients

Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

  • Strong pipeline management skills and a consistent record of exceeding outbound sales targets

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and negotiation abilities

  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently

  • Based in Belo Horizonte - MG

  • Working proficiency in Portuguese

  • Intermediate proficiency in English (reading, writing, and verbal communication)

Nice to haves

  • Experience in SaaS or the financial industry

  • Network within the financial ecosystem

  • Basic proficiency in Spanish or a desire to learn

  • Experience or interest in using AI tools to automate workflows

  • A good sense of humor

Why join Clara

At Clara, you’ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are

  • We’re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America.

  • Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work , and a LinkedIn Top Startup .

  • Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive.

  • Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive.

  • Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar.

  • Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment.

What we believe in

  • #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively.

  • #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters.

  • #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told.

  • #Pride. We build products and experiences we’re proud of.

  • #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action.

  • #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP ) from day one

  • Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language)

  • Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths

  • High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together

  • Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact

  • Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results

If you’re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Clara’s Hybrid Policy

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.

We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

title: Business Services Team Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Business Services Team Manager role at Canonical

Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration. This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management in a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.

We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy. Our team handles travel procurement and logistics to ensure events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations require a rigorous approach and high work ethic. The team also acts as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries, with integrity, transparency and accountability.

Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and involve a significant number of tactical and operational decisions. The team also provides traditional EA services for company leads, coordinating meetings, monthly reports, delegated approvals for travel and expenses, working across teams, coordinating with suppliers, and running small projects or initiatives.

Location: Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office (e.g., London, Taipei, Beijing).

Responsibilities

  • Travel approvals, logistics and operations
  • Expense review in line with policies
  • Planning of complex company events four times a year
  • Coordinate executive briefing and operational facilities through company offices
  • Global duty of care, health and safety programs with comprehensive policies and practices

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical or business subject
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond
  • Leadership and management skills
  • Sound judgement in money, policy and in-person interactions
  • Ability to work in a global, multicultural organization
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility
  • Responsibility, accountability, thoughtfulness and self-awareness
  • Result-oriented with personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel up to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long

Additional skills you might bring

  • Travel industry experience
  • Project management experience
  • Event management and operations experience
  • Business and corporate administration experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits reflecting our values and local needs. We balance our programs to ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, challenging you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a workplace free from discrimination, and we give fair consideration to every application regardless of identity.

Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

This position requires a strategic and process-oriented mindset , with the ability to design efficient recruitment pipelines, manage candidate pools at scale, and coordinate with multiple stakeholders globally.

  • Listen & Improve: Gather candidate feedback and implement process enhancements to ensure e2f remains a preferred opportunity in the freelance space.

  • Experience : 2–3 years of experience in high-volume recruitment, crowdsourcing, or freelancer/supply chain management.

  • Organized & Agile : You handle fast-changing priorities, tight deadlines, and large volumes with a cool head and sharp execution.
  • Collaborative : Comfortable working across time zones with remote, global teams.
  • Curious About AI : Interest in AI, data, and emerging tech is a strong plus.
  • Language : Proficient in English (written and spoken); multilingualism is a bonus.


Why you Might Be a Good Fit:

  • You like working in a startup environment, embracing dynamic and fast-evolving settings.

  • You like to talk with people from various backgrounds and personalities.
  • You like to give new ideas and not afraid to speak what is on your mind.

Why You Might Not Be a Good Fit:

  • You’re uncomfortable navigating ambiguity or working with limited documentation.

This isn’t for a traditional video editor or motion designer. You’re:

  • A visual storyteller who thinks like a marketer
  • A hook hunter who knows how to stop the scroll
  • A performance-driven marketer who obsesses over watch time, CTR, and ROAS
  • Someone who can create dozens of video variations quickly using AI tools, stock libraries, voiceovers, text overlays, memes, and trending formats

Your job is to make videos that convert . Not to win awards.

Not a Fit If

  • Specialize in long-form, cinematic, or branded content
  • Don’t know what makes someone stop scrolling
  • Need a detailed storyboard before starting
  • Haven’t tested your videos in a paid ad environment

You don’t need to be perfect, but you do need to:

  • Understand why some videos work and others flop — and learn

  • Put performance first — clicks, conversions, and watch time over polish

If you’ve made ads for VSLs, affiliate offers, or viral TikToks , you’re already halfway there.

title: Software Support Engineer
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. This role is remote, with teams in all time zones.

We are hiring a Software Support Engineer to work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux-based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. This role will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications used by large enterprise customers.

This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers work productively at any level of the stack, including the kernel, to understand and address software issues. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.

Location

Remote role; we have teams in all time zones.

Responsibilities

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, Kubernetes, or other open source software
  • Maintain close working relationships with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage time effectively against priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice-to-have skills

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about, Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD, PostgreSQL, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • Sólida experiência em operações de cybersecurity e em coordenação ou liderança.

  • Conhecimento comprovado em infraestrutura, cloud security (Azure, GCP, AWS) e frameworks de segurança and security frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, etc.).
  • Fluente em inglês.

title: Software Maintenance Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Software Maintenance Engineer role at Canonical

Location: This is a remote role; we have teams in all time zones.

Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This role involves working in a dynamic Linux-based infrastructure and applications environment, spanning all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications used by large enterprise customers.

This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.

Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.

Responsibilities

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical\'s Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice-to-have skills

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD, PostgreSQL, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems

What we offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Sobre a Allintra

Sobre a Allintra
A Allintra é uma startup brasileira de tecnologia com uma missão ambiciosa: transformar a forma como o trading de criptoativos é feito no Brasil. Estamos construindo uma plataforma de investimento de nível profissional, inteligente e colaborativa — conectando traders experientes a investidores em um ecossistema seguro, transparente e poderoso.

Estamos no momento mais decisivo da nossa jornada : o lançamento do Beta Test privado da plataforma. E para garantir que essa fase seja inesquecível para nossos primeiros 500 usuários, buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por experiência do cliente, tecnologia e construção de comunidade.

Sua missão

Você será a ponte entre nossos usuários e o time Allintra. Vai garantir que os traders se sintam ouvidos, valorizados e empoderados, transformando seus feedbacks em decisões estratégicas de produto. Durante o lançamento, será responsável por cultivar uma comunidade ativa, acompanhar a jornada dos primeiros usuários e traduzir suas experiências em insights acionáveis.

Você irá atuar diretamente na construção da jornada dos usuários reais, desenvolvendo processos de engajamento, estruturando canais de escuta e ajudando a consolidar uma cultura de produto centrada no cliente. Mais do que suporte, buscamos o protagonista na criação de experiências que encantem, envolvam e gerem valor real.

O que buscamos

O que oferecemos
